name: playwright-cucumber-node24-enterprise
description: Enterprise-style Playwright + Cucumber.js + TypeScript automation framework on Node.js 24.

scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean && npm run build && cross-env HEADLESS=false cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
scripts.test:chromium: npm run clean && npm run build && cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean && npm run build && cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean && npm run build && cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --tags '@smoke'
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --tags '@regression'
scripts.test:parallel: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --parallel 2
scripts.test:dry: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --dry-run
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:api: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --tags "@api"
scripts.test:ui: npm run clean && npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --tags "not @api"
